policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM driver_loans l
  WHERE ((l.id = driver_loan_transactions.loan_id) AND private.can_driver('loans.view'::text, l.driver_id, l.created_by))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM driver_payments p
  WHERE ((p.id = driver_payment_allocations.payment_id) AND private.can_driver('payments.view'::text, p.driver_id, p.created_by))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM import_batches b
  WHERE ((b.id = import_rows.batch_id) AND (b.created_by = auth.uid()) AND private.can('imports.manage'::text))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM maintenance_records m
  WHERE ((m.id = maintenance_components.maintenance_id) AND private.can('maintenance.view'::text, m.vehicle_id, m.created_by))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM maintenance_records m
  WHERE ((m.id = maintenance_items.maintenance_id) AND private.can('maintenance.view'::text, m.vehicle_id, m.created_by))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM maintenance_records m
  WHERE ((m.id = oil_changes.maintenance_id) AND private.can('maintenance.view'::text, m.vehicle_id, m.created_by))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM trips t
  WHERE ((t.id = trip_expense_lines.trip_id) AND private.can('trips.finance.view'::text, t.vehicle_id, t.created_by))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM trips t
  WHERE ((t.id = trip_financials.trip_id) AND private.can('trips.finance.view'::text, t.vehicle_id, t.created_by))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM trips t
  WHERE ((t.id = trip_status_history.trip_id) AND private.can('trips.view'::text, t.vehicle_id, t.created_by))))
